title: Binary-SPA: a reference-free method for cell annotation in high-resolution spatial transcriptomics.
snippet: Accurate cell annotation is a primary challenge in spatial transcriptomics (ST). Current approaches primarily rely on label transfer from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) reference or marker-based clustering.
